name: Íth

attributes.attribute: the first Milesian to spot Ireland on the horizon, killed by the Tuatha Dé Danann
Íth's nephew, who avenged his murder by leading the Milesian invasion

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Íth was an Irish hero. He appears in the Book of Invasions. He was the first of his tribe, the Milesians, to spot the green island of Ireland on the horizon. He led a group of his people there. The magical Tuatha Dé Danann, who already lived on the land, quickly killed him. His nephew Míl Despaine avenged his murder. Míl led the Milesians in a successful invasion of Ireland.
objective: Document Íth as an Irish hero of the Book of Invasions.
key_results: Record how Íth first spotted Ireland.
Tell his death at the hands of the Tuatha Dé Danann.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Íth entry.
